  86 │         value is passed while instantiating.

  90 │         ``attrs``-generated ``__init__`` methods with the :class:`Attribute` as

 132 │     specified attributes using :func:`attr.ib`.

 135 │         represantation of ``attrs`` attributes..

 139 │         ``__gt__``, and ``__ge__`` methods that compare the class as if it were
 140 │         a tuple of its ``attrs`` attributes.  But the attributes are *only*
 141 │         compared, if the type of both classes is *identical*!
 142 │     :type add_cmp: bool
 143 │

 145 │         a tuple of all ``attrs`` attribute values.
 146 │     :type add_hash: bool

 149 │         attributes.  Leading underscores are stripped for the argument name:.
 150 │

 154 │             >>> @attr.s
 155 │             ... class C(object):
 156 │             ...     _private = attr.ib()
 157 │             >>> C(private=42)
 158 │             C(_private=42)
 159 │     :type add_init: bool
 160 │     """

 162 │     # if it's used as `@_add_methods` but ``None`` (or a value passed) if used
 163 │     # as `@_add_methods()`.
 164 │     if isinstance(maybe_cl, type):
 165 │         _transform_attrs(maybe_cl)
 166 │         return _add_init(_add_hash(_add_cmp(_add_repr(maybe_cl))))
 167 │     else:

 176 │             if add_init is True:
 177 │                 cl = _add_init(cl)
 178 │             return cl
 179 │ 
 180 │         return wrap
